content.text:
Based on the Mistral documentation, the imports depend on your language:

**Python:**
```python
from mistralai.extra import response_format_from_pydantic_model
```

**TypeScript:**
```typescript
import { responseFormatFromZodObject } from '@mistralai/mistralai/extra/structChat.js';
```

Both helpers convert your Pydantic or Zod models into the format expected by the `bbox_annotation_format` parameter in the OCR API call.

See the full example at [https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/document-processing/annotations#usage](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/document-processing/annotations#usage)
